title: YZF-R7 HO
description: Representing Yamaha's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Yamaha YZF-R7 HO is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
